## Update 1.3.3 Beta 2

**Bug Fixes:**
* Fully Local works again: it now uses Feather's own certificate for local.feather.madebynuz.dev, which renews automatically and is replaced if it's ever revoked
* If Fully Local can't start an install, for example because your network blocks its address, Feather offers to switch to Semi Local instead of waiting on Ready
* The install sheet has a bigger app icon and no extra box inside it
